headline: Bloody body of youth recovered from Abdullahpur Flyover
summary: Police have recovered the bloody body of a young man from the Abdullahpur Flyover. An investigation has been launched to determine the cause of death and identify the deceased.
details: The body of an unidentified young man was discovered with visible injuries on the Abdullahpur Flyover. Local residents first noticed the body and alerted authorities, prompting a swift response from law enforcement.

Upon arrival, police secured the scene and initiated preliminary investigations. The nature of the injuries suggests a possible accident or foul play, though no definitive cause has been established yet.

The body has been sent to a local hospital for autopsy to ascertain the exact cause of death. Police are also working to identify the deceased and locate any potential witnesses who might have information regarding the incident.

Authorities are urging anyone with information that could assist in the investigation to come forward. Efforts are underway to review CCTV footage from the area to piece together the events leading to the discovery.
